text: 《2025年度国家老龄事业发展公报》显示，我国老年人福利津补贴覆盖范围继续扩大。截至2025年末，全国享受老年人津补贴人数5353.8万人，其中高龄津贴4145.9万人，护理补贴91.6万人，养老服务补贴585.8万人，综合补贴530.5万人。2025年，全国各级财政用于养老服务和老年人福利领域的支出约1200亿元，其中中央财政支出超300亿元。全国共有60周岁及以上持证残疾老年人1974.2万人，残疾人两项补贴惠及1043万残疾老年人，占领取残疾人两项补贴人数的50.4%。
text_en: The 2025 National Report on Aging Development shows continued expansion in coverage of welfare subsidies for the elderly. As of end-2025, 53.538 million seniors nationwide received old-age subsidies, including 41.459 million receiving senior allowance, 916,000 receiving nursing allowance, 5.858 million receiving eldercare service subsidy, and 5.305 million receiving comprehensive subsidy. In 2025, fiscal spending at all government levels on eldercare services and senior welfare totaled about 120 billion yuan, of which central fiscal expenditure exceeded 30 billion yuan. There were 19.742 million certified disabled seniors aged 60 and above nationwide, and the two disability subsidies benefited 10.43 million disabled seniors, accounting for 50.4% of all recipients of the two subsidies.
